description: Ordered complete CSS rules, including unchanged declarations and enclosing media/support/keyframe conditions. Offsets refer to mechanical checkpoint source; files are linked in this order.

rules.selector:
body.density-compact .rec-field input,
      body.density-compact .rec-field select,
      body.density-compact .rec-field textarea

body.density-compact .data-pagination-edge,
      body.density-compact .data-pagination-prev,
      body.density-compact .data-pagination-next,
      body.density-compact .data-pagination-page,
      body.density-compact .data-pagination-size select

body.style-floated
        .customer-overlay
        label.rec-field:not(.customer-dialog-toggle):focus-within
        > span:first-child,
      body.style-floated
        .customer-overlay
        label.rec-field:not(.customer-dialog-toggle):has(input:not(:placeholder-shown))
        > span:first-child,
      body.style-floated
        .customer-overlay
        label.rec-field:not(.customer-dialog-toggle):has(select)
        > span:first-child,
      body.style-floated
        .customer-overlay
        label.rec-field:not(.customer-dialog-toggle):has(textarea:not(:placeholder-shown))
        > span:first-child

body.style-floated .rec-field:has(input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus) label,
      body.style-floated .rec-field:has(input:not(:placeholder-shown)) label,
      body.style-floated .rec-field:has(select) label,
      body.style-floated .rec-field:has(input[type='date']) label,
      body.style-floated .rec-field:has(input:disabled) label

body.style-floated .rec-field input,
      body.style-floated .rec-field select,
      body.style-floated .rec-field textarea

body.style-inline .rec-field input,
      body.style-inline .rec-field select,
      body.style-inline .rec-field textarea

body.style-inline .rec-field input:is(:hover, :focus-visible),
      body.style-inline .rec-field select:is(:hover, :focus-visible),
      body.style-inline .rec-field textarea:is(:hover, :focus-visible)

body.style-inline .rec-field input:focus-visible,
      body.style-inline .rec-field select:focus-visible,
      body.style-inline .rec-field textarea:focus-visible

body.style-inline .rec-field input:disabled,
      body.style-inline .rec-field select:disabled,
      body.style-inline .rec-field textarea:disabled
